title: Satin column under sewing type 5 (second row, third button (lines icon))
description: A 39.5 x 6 mm satin column (density 4.5) with PE-DESIGN's type 5: second row, third button (lines icon). One of six files that differ only in the under sewing button (types 1-5 and off). Issue #124. Drawn with shape.column (Manual Punch, lines (10,10)-(10,16) and (49.5,10)-(49.5,16)), as PE-DESIGN's file is a Manual Punch Straight Block: OpenStitch sews a column's under sewing 0.5 mm inside its rails (edge run, piping, zigzag), the buttons mapped onto the styles (edgeZigzag / double = types 1-2, edge = types 3 and 5, zigzag = type 4). Until 2026-10-29 the spec drew a Rectangle-tool shape, whose region under sewing and split satin PE does not sew here.

featureMatrix.feature: Satin: a zigzag across the column

evidence.note: PE-DESIGN 11.50 (pe-refs-4, 2026-10-29): for a Satin region all five under sewing type buttons are enabled (Fill enables only the first row) and they are exclusive radio buttons: no combination of types is possible. On this 39.5 x 6 mm column: type 1 287 st, type 2 287, type 3 226, type 4 250, type 5 226, off 186 (issue #124)

references.make: Shapes > Manual Punch > Straight Block, clicks (10,10) (10,16) (50,10), double-click (50,16) mm (PE-DESIGN makes a 39.5 x 6 mm satin block: line Not Sewn, region Satin Stitch, density 4.5, Half Stitch on, pull 0.0, direction across the block); Sewing Attributes > Region sew > Under sewing ticked, type button second row, third button (lines icon), Density Medium. Save As PES (default type).
